March 12, 2018 - By Dolores Ford 
Bedell Frazier Investment Counseling Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 1.72% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bedell Frazier Investment Counseling Llc sold 1,970 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 112,788 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $17.38 million, down from 114,758 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bedell Frazier Investment Counseling Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $922.96B market cap company. The stock increased 1.07% or $1.92   $181.9. About 15.97 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500.

It also increased its holding in West Corp (NASDAQ:WSTC) by 46,711 shares in the quarter, for a total of 350,554 shares, and has risen its stake in Forestar Group Inc (NYSE:FOR). 
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on May, 1. They expect $2.72 earnings per share, up 29.52% or $0.62 from last year’s $2.1 per share.
